structure_policy_rationale: 钉钉的原始图标本身就是高度抽象的几何符号（翅膀+闪电），并非写实场景或复杂人物。根据 theme_rules 中 'preserve_when' 的定义，当 Original 为清晰几何符号时，必须保留其主体轮廓和空间布局。因此，不应重构为其他物体，而应直接对现有轮廓进行主题化填充和描边处理。
preserve: 翅膀与闪电融合的单一外轮廓剪影
图形中上部的三条平行弧形分割线（代表羽毛/速度）
底部向右下延伸的锐利闪电折角
整体向右上方冲势的几何重心
must_preserve: 品牌识别线索：三道弧线切口
recompose_allowed: 内部色块的颜色分配（映射为红/蓝/黄/白）
边缘线条的粗糙度与手绘质感
restyle: 将平滑矢量边缘转化为粗犷、抖动的马克笔/蜡笔手绘线条
去除所有渐变、高光和立体阴影，改为纯色块平涂
模拟干性绘画介质（蜡笔/粉笔）的颗粒感与不均匀填充
decorate: 添加粗重的黑色/深色不规则手绘描边
保持极简，除主体外无额外装饰元素
forbid: 保留原始的蓝色渐变背景或科技蓝光效
使用平滑、锐利的工业级贝塞尔曲线
添加任何立体光影、投影或环境光遮蔽
改变翅膀的基本拓扑结构或将其具象化为真实鸟类
使用主题色板（红/蓝/黄/白/黑）之外的颜色
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon of DingTalk logo on pure black background. Simplified wing-lightning shape with three feather cuts. Thick, rough marker-style outline in dark color. Flat solid fills using high-saturation retro primary colors (deep blue, brick red, warm yellow). No gradients, no shadows, no glossy effects. Naive, clumsy, cute aesthetic with crayon texture.
color_application: Map original brand blue to theme's Deep Blue/Indigo or Brick Red for main body; use Warm Yellow/Cream for feather accents or highlights. Strictly flat, high-saturation solid blocks. No gradients.
stroke_application: Apply thick, uneven, hand-drawn black/dark outline around the entire wing-lightning silhouette and internal feather divisions. Simulate marker pen pressure variations and rough edges.
composition_application: Center the simplified wing-lightning symbol. Occupy 60-70% of canvas area. Ensure balanced negative space against the pure black background. Remove all original background elements.
identity_application: Maintain the exact topological structure of the wing-lightning composite: the upward sweep, the three distinct feather arcs, and the sharp bottom-right lightning angle. Recognizability relies on this specific geometric arrangement, not color.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough, hand-drawn style strokes
Colors must be limited to high-saturation Red, Blue, Yellow/White palette
No gradients, shadows, or 3D rendering allowed
Subject must be flat geometric blocks with crayon/marker texture
negative_constraints: No realistic bird wings or animal features
No smooth vector lines or perfect symmetry
No original brand blue gradient or white background
No neon glow or lighting effects
